Specification: This specification models a trivial one-variable state machine in which the single variable x is initialized to the constant Value, and every next-state step leaves x unchanged. The file defines two constant-valued operators, Value and Value2, but only Value is used in the initialization. It also defines a simple invariant-like state predicate Inv asserting that x = 2, which does not hold in the initial state because Init sets x to 0; there are no temporal properties, fairness conditions, proofs, or fault-model constructs in the file.
